name: Alpine Food Distributing
old_description: Since 1983, Alpine Food Distributing, Inc. has been a leading force in Redistribution, servicing the food distribution industry, proudly serving the Western United States from our base in Portland, Oregon.
about:
Alpine Food Distributing operates from Milwaukie, Oregon, in the Portland metropolitan area. The family-owned company was founded in 1983 as a redistribution specialist serving the food distribution industry across the Western United States.

The redistributor manages more than 10,000 food products across 620,000 square feet of temperature-controlled warehouse space. Its service platform includes cross-docking, trans-shipments, and just-in-time delivery supported by a fleet of multi-temperature trailers. A new distribution facility in Southern California expands its reach.

Alpine serves food suppliers and distributors in ten western states: Alaska, Arizona, California, Hawaii, Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, Utah, Washington, and western Montana. Customers range from regional distributors to national brands seeking redistribution into the Pacific Northwest and beyond.

The company emphasizes transparent support and flexible order management, offering lower minimums and competitive pricing compared to traditional distribution models. Its value proposition centers on personalized service and supply-chain efficiency for vendors and buyers alike.
